property_summary: For any inputs, the reference contract's getPrice view function must not return a non-zero value (it performs no observable return), while the mutant returns 1 for some inputs, so a universal property is that calling getPrice does not produce a non-zero int256 result — the mutant breaks this by returning 1.
change_summary: Return a constant non-zero int256 value (1) instead of having an empty body, changing observable return.
